title: [Advisory] VMware vCenter: Critical Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-123903)
content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:

- Successful exploitation allows unauthenticated attackers with network access to compromise vCenter authentication, potentially exposing centralized virtual infrastructure management.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:

- Broadcom VMware vCenter
- Broadcom VMware Cloud Foundation
- Broadcom VMware vSphere Foundation
- Broadcom VMware Telco Cloud Platform
- Broadcom VMware Telco Cloud Infrastructure

For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:

- **Prerequisites:** Network access to VMware vCenter
- **Impact Details:** Additional flaws permit appliance code execution through malicious archive processing or denial of service against VMware Directory Service.
- **Available Mitigations:**
  - Vendor patches are available

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:

- CVE-2026-123903 CVSS3.1: 9.8 (CRITICAL) - VMware Directory Service authentication bypass enabling unauthorized vCenter access
- CVE-2026-123904 CVSS3.1: 7.5 (HIGH) - Arbitrary file write during archive processing may enable appliance code execution
- CVE-2026-123905 CVSS3.1: 7.5 (HIGH) - VMware Directory Service denial-of-service vulnerability
- CVE-2026-123906 CVSS3.1: 7.5 (HIGH) - Separate VMware Directory Service denial-of-service condition
- CVE-2026-123907 CVSS3.1: 7.5 (HIGH) - Additional VMware Directory Service denial-of-service flaw

##### REFERENCES:

*Timestamp of the Information: 24.11.2026, 16:06*
summary: A critical vulnerability in VMware vCenter allows unauthenticated network attackers to bypass VMware Directory Service authentication and gain unauthorized system access. Broadcom also addressed related code-execution and denial-of-service vulnerabilities affecting vCenter deployments.
